description: Implementation of CustomerOptionSetDao interface for accessing CustomerOptionSet entities from the database, including methods for retrieving by ID, option ID, option value ID, and listing by store and language.

classes.name: CustomerOptionSetDaoImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation class for CustomerOptionSet entity, providing database access methods.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerOptionSet by its ID, fetching associated customer options and values.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerOptionSet entities by a specific option ID and store.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerOptionSet entities by a specific option value ID and store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists CustomerOptionSet entities for a given store and language, including descriptions.
